xor-latest.description: Recommended - XOR text alias; boolean, choice and score questions, 2 to 64 options each

xor-omni.description: XOR multimodal alias; reads images and video alongside the state, for boolean, choice and score questions

xor-1.1.description: Name served by the deprecated /v1/systemone route; superseded by xor-latest and xor-omni. Still sent as given when you name it - the endpoint decides whether it accepts it

setup.description: API key for your XOR endpoint
instructions: 1. Reach an XOR deployment, or use a LiteLLM proxy with a pass-through route to one
2. Set XOR_BASE_URL to its origin (NeuroLink calls <XOR_BASE_URL>/v1/decisions)
3. Set {apiKeyEnvVar} to the key it accepts (on LiteLLM, a virtual key whose team allows xor-latest, and xor-omni for media)

rosterVerified.method: POST <origin>/v1/decisions with model xor-latest and a 3-option choice question returned HTTP 200 with served model xor-text-2, through NeuroLink's decide(); a 65-option choice question returned HTTP 422 reading 2..64 options, got 65. A 64-option question returned 200 and 77 options returned 422 on both aliases when probed by hand the same day. A successful xor-omni answer, and any image, audio or video request, were not exercised. The figures contextWindow 250000, maxOutputTokens 256, the 200000-token state window and the media limits are carried over from xor-1.1, not re-measured for the aliases; xor-1.1 is kept only as a retired name
